messages.author: 1d4b6bcd63443185
messages.subject: Implementing progress bar for each output plot
parts:
Hi all, I have an app with 10 output plots and different conditionalpanels. I am needing to add a load progress in each output plot (I evaluated to use https://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/progress-bar-example.html but this don't work as I want).

I was evaluating these options:

1- Add css to show a gif using the class "recalculating" (also I hide the elements inside of divs when we have recalculating class) added when plot is recalculated.

The problem here was that the class "recalculating" dissapeared 1 second previous to show the new graph. So the old graph previous to recalculate was visibible too. And that is confused.
I saw which this is the standard behavior in doc: https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/js-events.html . 


2- I thought to use an event more general as "shiny-busy" , and show a load bar in each plots until that all app is ready.

The problem here was that I have an intermittence in event shiny-busy (the shiny-bussy appear a few seconds, dissapear, and return again).

I can add an setInterval as this example: 
http://withr.me/add-calculation-in-process-indictor-for-shiny-application/  but not always worked correctly.


Some better idea about this? 

Thanks in advance

messages.subject: Re: Implementing progress bar for each output plot
parts:
Hi Joe, thank you for your time, maybe I was not so clear. My current structure is the following:

- 2 inputs (selection of users and groups)
- 6 plots and 1 table showing when inputs are not selected, this would work as "general report". (when a user is selected, showing only 3 plots of these).
- 3 plots and 1 table showing if a user was selected (this is using conditionalPanel), this would be "individual report".

When I select an user, by a second I can see the old plot (shown in general report) before to show the new plot filtered by user selected.

In this moment I found a solution with the following:

Hiding the img when is recalculating: 
.recalculating img {
  visibility:hidden;
}

Removing the opacity in .recalculating:
.recalculating{
  opacity:0;
}

Adding a js that add a new class to output div when event "shiny:recalculating" is thrown. Also this new class is removed when event "shiny:value" is thrown:
$(document).on('shiny:recalculating', function(event) {
  $("#"+event.target.id+".shiny-plot-output").addClass("hide-content-recalculating");
});

$(document).on('shiny:value', function(event) {
  setTimeout(function() {
    $("#"+event.target.id+".shiny-plot-output").removeClass("hide-content-recalculating");
  }, 300);
});

and adding a gif with a bar progress in new class "hide-content-recalculating":
.hide-content-recalculating img{
  visibility:hidden;
}
.hide-content-recalculating{
  background-image: url("../pix/barload.gif");
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-position: center center;
}


What do you think? Thanks in advance.
